Reading this dashboard: each office's data covers incidents recorded by local police within roughly 0.5km of the site, April 2025 – April 2026. Crime categories are normalized across NYC, London, and Vancouver source schemas into a shared set (see category chips) — exact original offense labels are shown in each point's popup. Vancouver 2025 data was corrected from an initial export that only contained 2026 records.
